title: openmct.realtime.v1
description: One ChronusGateway telemetry message: a CCSDS Space Packet plus its physics co-validation result. Sent as one WebSocket text message per packet on GET /telemetry/openmct, and returned by the history API. v1 grows only additively: consumers must ignore fields they do not know, and the fields marked 'additive' may be absent in output from older gateways.

received_at.description: Gateway receive time (UTC). The Open MCT 'utc' domain.

physics_flags.description: Co-validation alarm bits (Methodology D-016): 0 Doppler, 1 below horizon, 2 link budget, 3 pointing, 4 EPS, 5 thermal, 6 body rate (4-6 are HIL lab models), 7 reserved. 0 = nominal.

source.description: Sender ip:port of the UDP datagram.

elevation_deg.description: Predicted geometric elevation; null without physics.

azimuth_deg.description: Predicted azimuth, clockwise from true north; null without physics.

range_km.description: Predicted slant range; null without physics.

range_rate_km_s.description: Predicted range rate, positive receding; null without physics.

apparent_elevation_deg.description: Additive (0.2). Refracted elevation the antenna should point at.

doppler_tolerance_hz.description: Additive (0.2). Doppler acceptance band applied to this packet.

physics_flags_v2.description: Additive (0.4). Time alarm bits: 0 time-tag skew, 1 time code invalid.

onboard_time.description: Additive (0.4). Spacecraft time decoded from the secondary header; absent when not decoded.

physics_time.description: Additive (0.4). The instant physics was evaluated at.

rf_matched.description: Additive (0.4). Whether receiver measurements were available for this packet.

vcid.description: Additive (0.5). Virtual channel the packet arrived on; absent unless the link carries TM Transfer Frames.

payload_base64.description: Base64 of the packet data field (secondary header + user data).
